test_intent: Verifies that MessageHandler delegates /stats command handling to CommandRouter by calling HandleCommandAsync.
reason: Tests that command routing through CommandRouter works from MessageHandler. Single clean mock verify at the correct seam. The behavior (commands go through router) is a real bot contract. Low maintenance cost with one mock verify.

test_intent: Claims to verify logging of command handling, but only asserts that CommandRouter.HandleCommandAsync was called once.
reason: Duplicate of HandleCommandAsync_WithStatsCommand_CallsCommandRouter. The only assertion is the same CommandRouter mock verify. Despite the name suggesting logging verification, no logging is actually asserted. No unique behavior to preserve; the routing contract is already covered by the sibling test.

test_intent: Verifies that UserBanService.BanUserForLongNameAsync bans the user, deletes the message, sends a log notification, and logs the ban event when the chat is a group.
reason: Strong contract test at the correct seam. Four targeted mock verifies covering ban execution (with correct ban expiry check), message deletion, notification forwarding, and logging. Uses stable test data via TK helpers. Tests a core bot safety behavior directly.

test_intent: Verifies that UserBanService.BanUserForLongNameAsync bans the user, deletes the message, sends a log notification, and logs the ban event when the chat is a group.
reason: Exact duplicate of the same test in UserBanServiceTests.Modern.cs (same method name, same assertions, same behavior). The legacy file UserBanServiceTests.cs is being superseded by the .Modern variant. The Modern version uses the same TK helpers and identical mock verifies. No unique behavior to preserve; the contract is fully covered by the Modern test.

test_intent: Calls real AI API via AiChecks.GetAttentionBaitProbability with a suspicious user profile and asserts the result is non-null with a valid probability.
reason: Currently ignored with [Ignore] attribute, so it never runs in CI. Calls real external AI API making it flaky and expensive. Assertions are weak (NotBeNull, BeGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0.0)) and provide no meaningful contract coverage. The behavior (AI integration works) is valuable but this test is too brittle to keep and too uncertain to delete. A proper contract test against IAiChecks with mocked HTTP would be more useful.

test_intent: Verifies that when a user message triggers moderation violation, MessageHandler calls UserBanService.AutoBanAsync to ban the user.
reason: Tests the integration seam between MessageHandler and UserBanService for auto-ban flow. Uses MessageEnvelope for proper message tracking. Single mock verify that UserBanService.AutoBanAsync is called. The behavior (handler delegates ban to service) is a real bot contract. Factory setup is moderate but acceptable for an integration test.

test_intent: Verifies that when a channel-sent message arrives, MessageHandler delegates handling to ChannelModerationService.
reason: Tests channel message routing from MessageHandler to ChannelModerationService. Uses MessageEnvelope and factory setup. Single mock verify on ChannelModerationService.HandleChannelMessageAsync. The behavior (channel messages go through moderation service) is a real bot contract. Complements the user auto-ban test with a different message source.
